description: Server-side JavaScript code for a database visualization API using Express.js, supporting multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB), with environment variable loading, database connection testing, and API endpoints for retrieving database info.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, defining interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, providing common SQL query execution and table/data retrieval methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite, implementing execute, getTableQuery, and getDataQuery methods.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB, implementing testConnection, getTables, and getData methods.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different databases.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and returns list of successful ones.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests, executing operations on specified database adapters.
